method: SSH brackets board monotonic clock; first-frame origin is conservatively bounded by launch and first FFmpeg progress receipt. Actual frame PTS are retained. No optical input latency or every-refresh claim.

full.limits: 48 sampled frames in two contact sheets; inspect MP4 for temporal detail. No fixed-ROI brightness proxy used because camera framing changed. Camera sampling cannot exclude transient blanking/tearing between frames.

reduced.limits: 48 sampled frames in two contact sheets; inspect MP4 for temporal detail. No fixed-ROI brightness proxy used because camera framing changed. Camera sampling cannot exclude transient blanking/tearing between frames.
